atomic_task_contract.verification_rule: Only AION PM may advance to verified after independent source-backed evidence review.
atomic_task_contract.assignment_rule: One accountable owner per task; assignment in ledger does not prove agent receipt.
atomic_task_contract.communication_rule: All team communication in the same ChatGPT 001.PROJECTS.PM conversation; GitHub is durable evidence and ledger, not chat or execution authority.
atomic_task_contract.seed_rule: No new build without an existing planned capability seed and reuse check.
atomic_task_contract.human_rule: Owen is strategic authority; BFF handles exception-only reporting; no owner task tracking.
atomic_task_contract.security_rule: Existing D4 GitHub execution dispatch freeze remains; no Windows execution without explicit scoped authorization.
atomic_task_contract.append_rule: Future tasks append as AT-101 onward; do not reset or replace these 100.
